name: jobs
title: Background jobs
description: Background jobs and cron on MongoDB (no Redis): retries with backoff, schedules, event triggers, admin API and a devtools panel.
docs:
Jobs live in app/jobs/*.js (see welcome-email.js):
  export default defineJob({ name, run(data, { app, job, log }), retries, schedule: '0 * * * *' | 'every 5m', on: 'auth.registered' })
Enqueue from anywhere: ctx.app.ext.jobs.enqueue('name', data, { delay: '10m' })
Admin API: GET /api/jobs, GET /api/jobs/stats, POST /api/jobs/:id/retry. Set JOBS_WORKER=off on instances that should not process jobs.
